feeds.title: Creditcard.com.au Blog
feeds.description: At CreditCard.com.au, they bring together the latest credit card offers, so you can compare the options and find the best credit card for your needs. Using their wealth of experience in the industry, they make it easy for you to search for credit cards by comparing their fees and features side-by-side. Get into their blog and learn more about their features, banks, brands, informational articles, tips, and more.

feeds.title: Credit Simple Blog
feeds.description: Credit Simple is part of the illion group of companies which include a leading credit bureau in Australia. They've created tools for you to see how you compare to your friends and your community, as well as being able to access great deals such as loans and credit cards. They're transparent about how they make money - they get a commission if you take up an offer through their site. Explore more through their blog about the latest news, tips, offers, services, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Tippla » Credit Score
feeds.description: Take a walk through their blog which features the latest news, insights, articles, services, and more. Tippla is a tool that helps Aussies understand the difference between their credit scores and what affects them. They are ready to help give you all the information you need to understand your credit scores and credit reports, as well as boost your rating. They have created their credit school to guide you through every element of your credit scores and reports.

feeds.title: Get Credit Score
feeds.description: Get Credit Score to believe access to your personal credit score is your right, and an important step in helping you on your way to greater financial health. Your information is protected via identity checks and encryption. They retrieve your credit score directly from Equifax. Check out their blog and learn more about their services, offers, latest news, reviews, articles, reports, and much more.

feeds.title: Australian Frequent Flyer » Credit Cards
feeds.description: Check out their blog and learn more about tips, tricks, articles, services, and more. The Australian Frequent Flyer is Australia's leading Frequent Flyer community and Travel website, established in 1998 by Clifford Reichlin. They are an independent, privately owned company that is not affiliated with any airline or reward program. They cover a wide range of topics from airlines, miles and points, and loyalty programs, to travel lifestyle and trip reports and reviews.

feeds.title: Credit Repair Australia Blog
feeds.description: Since 2003, Credit Repair Australia has been one of the country's foremost consumer credit restoration experts, and they have assisted thousands of Australians in taking control of their finances. They can access your reports from three main providers to assess your credit rating, and they'll provide a consultation to work with you to provide the solutions to improve your credit score. Go through their blog and learn more about their services, offers, testimonials, articles, tips, and more.
